name: Day Land Tour Bartolomé
highlights: • Bartolome is a volcanic islet located off the east coast of Santiago Island.
• 6:30 am leave the hotel.
• The island has one of the most beautiful landscapes in the archipelago.
• It has a volcanic cone that is easy to climb due to stairs and handrail. A grand view of other islands is seen from the top of the cone.
• The Pinnacle Rock is the distinctive characteristic of this island, and the most representative landmark of the Galapagos.
• Wildlife – Land: Lava Herons, Sally Light-foot Crabs, Galapagos Hawks, Lava Cacti.
Marine Wildlife: Sea Lions, Galapagos Penguins, Marine Iguanas, Galapagos Sharks, White-tip Sharks, Sea Turtles, Rays, Pelagic and Reef Fish.
• Difficulty Level: Moderate – some hiking – slope.
• Activities: Hiking, Snorkeling, Swimming.
include: • Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.

highlights: The Tunnels is a lava tube formation where you can go snorkeling and take a short walk (800 meters long). When snorkeling in the lava tube, you can see sea horses and turtles. During the walk sea marine iguanas, sea lions, and blue footed boobies can be observed .

13:00 back to Puerto Villamil

name: Day Land Tour Santa Cruz

• Afternoon tour to the German Beach if time permits.

name: Day Land Tour North Seymour
highlights: • The island is home to some of Galapagos birds such as blue- footed boobies
• It hosts one of the largest populations of magnificent frigatebirds.
• North Seymour has a visitor trail of approximately 2 kilometers in length crossing the island.

• Wildlife – Land: Blue-Footed Boobies, Frigatebirds, Colonies of Sea Lions, Marine Iguanas, Land Iguanas (occasionally), Swallow-tailed Gulls, Red-billed Tropicbirds and Nazca Boobies (occasionally).
Marine Wildlife: White-tip Sharks, Galapagos Sharks, Rays, Pelagic and Reef Fish.
• Difficulty Level: Moderate – some hiking over unpathed and rocky trails. The total distance of the trail is 2 miles.
• Activities: Hiking, Snorkeling Swimming
include: • Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.

name: 6 Day Adventure
description:
Day 1: Airport pick up. Visit the Chatos Reserve and view giant tortoises in their natural habitat. Includes
lunch in the Highlands at a private ranch.
Day 2: Hike to Tortuga Bay Beach to enjoy sunbathing, exploring and snorkeling. View sea turtles and
other sea creatures plus a population of iguanas. Optional return to Puerto Ayora via boat.
After lunch, take a tour of Charles Darwin Research station.
Day 3: Boat trip to North Seymour to walk through the nesting areas of blue footed boobies and frigate birds.
Day 4 : Snorkel at Pinzon Island.
Day 5:  Snorkeling tour to Santa Fe Island / Landing on a beach on Santa Cruz
Day 6: View the twin craters and transfer to the airport.

name: Kicker Rock Tour
highlights: Iconic Snorkeling: Experience two thrilling open-water snorkeling sessions in the famous channel of Kicker Rock.
Abundant Marine Life: Swim alongside hammerhead sharks, Galapagos sharks, sea turtles, rays, and playful sea lions.
Unique Bird Watching: Spot native coastal birds, including blue-footed boobies and frigatebirds, nesting directly on the towering rock walls.
Pristine Beaches: Relax, swim, and observe wildlife at a beautiful, secluded beach (Cerro Brujo, Manglecito, or Puerto Grande).
All-Inclusive Experience: Enjoy a hassle-free 7-hour adventure with lunch, towels, and premium snorkeling equipment included.
8:00 AM departure from Puerto Baquerizo Moreno, San Cristóbal.
3:00 PM return to Puerto Baquerizo Moreno.
include: • Transportation – pick up/ drop off at hotel.
